Title: Name change: End of Dv2-series VMs promotion

Body.Content:
The previously announced Dv2-series promotion will expire on September 1, 2018. At that time, we'll reinstate the standard pricing associated with the use of Dv2-series virtual machines. The price adjustment will be automatic, and it will become effective across all regions except for West Central US.

This change only affects pricing and meter names—on September 1, 2018. The existing GUIDs and how your Dv2 VMs operate will not change. See the following tables for name change details.

Depending on your requirements, you can resize your VMs and take advantage of the latest hyperthreaded generation of general-purpose VMs that the Dv3-series can offer, with the right combination of CPU, memory, and local disks for most production workloads at competitive price points. Additionally, the Ev3-series VMs are ideal for memory-intensive enterprise applications. After you resize your VMs, you'll also be able to purchase a reserved instance to achieve material cost savings.

For more information, visit the Azure VM pricing pages.

The previously announced Dv2-series promotion will expire on September 1, 2018. At that time, we'll reinstate the standard pricing associated with the use of Dv2-series virtual machines. The price adjustment will be automatic, and it will become effective across all regions except for West Central US.

This change only affects pricing and meter names—on September 1, 2018. The existing GUIDs and how your Dv2 VMs operate will not change. See the following tables for name change details.

Depending on your requirements, you can resize your VMs and take advantage of the latest hyperthreaded generation of general-purpose VMs that the Dv3-series can offer, with the right combination of CPU, memory, and local disks for most production workloads at competitive price points. Additionally, the Ev3-series VMs are ideal for memory-intensive enterprise applications. After you resize your VMs, you'll also be able to purchase a reserved instance to achieve material cost savings.

For more information, visit the Azure VM pricing pages .
